title: Viral Video Editor / Clipper — AI-Native, High Agency, Ships Fast
description:
Job Overview:

We're a US-based consumer app portfolio (mobile apps + web products) looking for a video editor who lives and breathes short-form content. You'll be cutting viral clips, building paid social ads (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest), and producing the kind of content that actually stops scrolls — not the generic templated stuff every other VA delivers.



This is not an entry-level "learn on the job" role. You've already shipped hundreds of edits. You know what a 3-second hook looks like. You know why one cut works and another dies in the algorithm.



What you'll do:

Cut long-form content (podcasts, founder videos, product demos) into 15-60 second clips optimized for TikTok, Reels, Shorts

Produce Meta/TikTok ad creative — UGC-style, demo-style, and hook-heavy direct response

Use AI tools (Higgsfield, Claude Code, ElevenLabs, Veo, CapCut AI, Submagic, etc.) to move 5x faster than traditional editors

Test variations relentlessly — hooks, captions, pacing, music

Hit weekly output targets (we'll align on volume during onboarding)



You must have:

2+ years editing short-form video professionally

A reel/portfolio with clips that actually performed (we want view counts, not just polished edits)

Native-level fluency with at least 3 of: CapCut, Premiere, Descript, Opus Clip, Submagic, Runway, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT/Claude for scripting

Obsessive about hooks, pacing, and captions

Async communication discipline (Loom, written updates, no babysitting required)



You are NOT a fit if:

You need detailed shot-by-shot instructions for every edit

You've never run or studied paid ads

You think "viral content" means slapping trending audio on B-roll

You need to be told to use AI tools



Bonus points:

Experience with US/Western audiences (you understand the humor, references, pacing)

You've worked on apps, SaaS, or DTC brands before

You can write your own hooks/captions without a script

You have opinions about what's working right now on TikTok and aren't afraid to push back



Compensation:

$Hourly with bonuses tied to performance (view metrics, ad ROAS, output velocity). Long-term role — we're building a team, not flipping VAs.



How to apply:

Send me:

Your best 3 clips with view counts / performance data (no view counts = auto-reject)

One sentence on the AI tool you'd be lost without and why

The word "scroll-stopper" in the first line of your application



Applications missing any of the above won't be reviewed. We get a lot of submissions.

Compensation:

- Hourly rate (based on experience and scope)

description:

Direct Employer | Remote

Rate: $5–$6/hour (based on experience)



Role Overview:

As a Foreclosure Assistance Specialist, you will speak with homeowners who are seeking help in

postponing or extending their foreclosure/auction date. You will guide them through our services,

answer their questions, and help them feel confident in choosing our service. Strong communication

and conversational skills are essential, along with the ability to subtly encourage enrollment without

How to Apply:



 your CV to 

Subject line: SAP – Foreclosure Assistance Specialist – [Your Name]

Attach a link to your voice recording reading the article below using 



1. What Is a Foreclosure Postponement?

“Many homeowners facing foreclosure are unaware that they may qualify for a postponement. A foreclosure postponement is a temporary delay granted by the county or court, giving the homeowner more time to gather documents, explore loss-mitigation options, or secure financial assistance. This extra time can be crucial, especially when homeowners are dealing with unexpected hardships. Understanding the process and deadlines is essential to increasing the chances of a successful postponement.”

2. Why Acting Early Matters in Foreclosure Situations

“When a homeowner receives a Notice of Default or an auction date, time becomes their most valuable resource. Acting early allows them to review options such as negotiating with their lender, filing for postponement, or exploring repayment plans. Many homeowners wait until the last few weeks, which limits their options. Early action can reduce stress and significantly improve the outcome of their case.”

3. The Importance of Verified Court Filings in Foreclosure Cases

“Submitting accurate and timely court filings can make a big difference in a foreclosure situation. Counties require specific documents, strict formatting, and deadlines that must be met exactly. Missing a requirement can cause delays or an automatic denial. That’s why many homeowners choose to work with assistance programs that specialize in preparing and filing documents on their behalf. Proper filing helps homeowners buy valuable time and avoid losing their property prematurely.”

4. Understanding Your Rights as a Homeowner Facing Foreclosure

“Homeowners facing foreclosure often feel overwhelmed, but it is important to remember that they still have rights. They have the right to receive proper notice, the right to request information from their lender, and in many cases, the right to seek postponement or review options. Knowing these rights helps homeowners make informed decisions rather than reacting out of fear. Education and support can make the process less intimidating.”

POSITION: Conversion Web Operator (WordPress + Elementor)

You don't wait for a designer to hand you a mockup. You read the brief, open Elementor, and build.



You know where the CTA goes before anyone tells you. You know why the headline matters more than the hero image. You check the mobile view without being asked. And when the page goes live, you already know what you'd test first.



If that's how you work, keep reading.



---



THE ROLE



Our company is a U.S.-based IT and cybersecurity company. We help small, mid to enterpise businesses stay secure, compliant, and running. Our SEO team generates organic traffic — your job is to make sure that traffic converts.



You will build and optimize landing pages in WordPress using Elementor. You will receive a brief. You will ship the page. Fast, clean, and built to convert. Every page you touch gets tracked in GA4. The data tells us if you're doing your job. So does the revision count.



---



WHAT YOUR WEEK LOOKS LIKE



- You receive page briefs with keyword targets, CTA goals, and structure notes

- You build or optimize 3+ pages from brief to live — desktop and mobile, both done right

- You can on-page SEO yourself: headings, meta, keyword placement, internal links

- You do not ask "what should it look like?" — you have instincts and you use them

- You submit delivery with a SEO Tools or call

- Friday: pages shipped, revision count, and any conversion data you tracked



---



THE STANDARD



This is not a goal. This is the floor:



- 3 pages shipped per week, atleast

- Every page live within 24 hours of an approved brief

- Maximum 2 revisions per deliverable — lower is better

- Measurable CTR or lead improvement on pages you optimize



If 24 hours feels too fast, this role will be frustrating. If it feels normal, we want to talk.



---



YOU ARE THE RIGHT FIT IF



- You have built landing pages in Elementor and can send us the live URLs right now

- You understand conversion — not just design. You know the difference between a page that looks good and a page that converts.

- You do on-page SEO as a default, not as an afterthought

- You deliver first drafts that are 90% there, not rough sketches that need three rounds of feedback

- You communicate when there's a blocker and solve it without being chased



---



YOU ARE NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF



- Every page you build starts with "can you send me a reference design?"

- You have never looked at GA4 to understand how a page is performing

- You treat SEO and design as two separate things that someone else handles

- Your average delivery time is "a few days" with no specific timeline







---



TEST TASK — NON-NEGOTIABLE



after interview, you will complete a short test task using real company context. You will build one above-the-fold section in Elementor — live link or video walkthrough required. No static screenshots accepted.



Details are sent after your application is reviewed. If you skip it, your application closes.



---

: 

with the subject line: WEB OPERATOR — [Your Name]

1. Two or three live URLs of landing pages you personally built in Elementor.

2. For one of those pages — tell us in two sentences what you would change to improve its conversion rate today.

3. Your available start date.

title: Influencer & UGC Outreach Coordinator
description:
Adventure Travel Brand - Long-Term Role



Before you apply - please read carefully



This is a relationship and outreach role. If you’re not comfortable with cold outreach, or setting up meetings and calls, this is not for you.



Excellent spoken and written English is essential. You will be on calls with influencers and creators - you need to handle yourself confidently and naturally.



Influencer marketing, brand partnerships, or e-commerce outreach experience is required. General virtual assistants without specific outreach experience will not be considered.



This is a long-term role. We are building this channel over years, not weeks. We are looking for a minimum 2-year commitment from you.



You must be available to work consistently 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.



About Us

This Big World is an adventure travel brand. Our flagship product is a deck of Travel Challenge Cards sold on Amazon - a deck that turns any trip into an adventure by challenging travellers to find local oddities, eat unfamiliar food, explore off the tourist trail, and break out of standard sightseeing routines. We sell to two audiences: adventure travellers (the people who use the cards) and gift-givers (the people who buy them for travellers in their life).



Our market is travellers and travel gift-buyers aged roughly 30+. We are not targeting Gen-Z TikTok travellers. Our audience is people with the means and inclination to travel adventurously, and the people who give them thoughtful gifts. The creators and influencers you identify for us should match this audience - adventure travellers, slow travellers, family travellers, couples in their 30s-60s, gift-giving accounts that speak to grown-up buyers.



We are a small, founder-led business currently travelling nomadically through the Americas. We have a Substack publication, a thousands-strong photo and video library from our travels (Colombia, Costa Rica, Brazil, and more to come), and an Amazon listing with reviews and an established product.



We are now ready to expand our reach through user-generated content (UGC) and influencer partnerships - putting our cards in the hands of adventure travellers, content creators, and gift-buyers around the world.



The Opportunity

We are hiring a dedicated Influencer & UGC Outreach Coordinator to take complete ownership of our outreach and partnerships channel. The role has two clear goals:



First: secure a steady stream of high-quality user-generated content. People using our cards on real trips, capturing real 
nts, that we can use across Pinterest, Amazon, our website, our Substack, and our social channels. UGC is the single most powerful conversion lever for an e-commerce brand. We need a lot of it, and we need it to be good.



Second: run influencer partnerships. Identifying the right creators in the adventure travel and gift-buying spaces, reaching out personally, building genuine relationships, and turning those relationships into content, exposure, and sales. We are not looking for someone who blasts templated DMs. We are looking for someone who can identify the right people, write to them like a human being, and build a real network of creators who genuinely love what we do.



You will work directly with the founder, have significant autonomy over your strategy and outreach approach, and own the channel end-to-end.



Your Responsibilities



1. UGC Programme

- Identify travellers, adventure enthusiasts, content creators, and everyday card users who would be great candidates to receive our cards in exchange for content.

- Reach out personally - by DM,
, or phone where appropriate - with messages that sound like a human wrote them, not a template.

- Manage the full lifecycle: first contact, agreement, shipping, content brief, content delivery, follow-up.

- Build a clear content brief that tells creators what we need (formats, angles, the kinds of 
nts we want captured) without being prescriptive about creativity.

- Organise, tag, and store all UGC so the team can quickly find and use it across our channels.

- Aim for steady, predictable UGC volume - we need a consistent stream, not occasional spikes.



2. Influencer Partnerships

- Identify suitable influencers and content creators in adventure travel, slow travel, family travel, couples travel, expat/nomad life, and the thoughtful-gift space. Focus on the 10k to 100k follower range initially, where engagement is highest and partnerships are most accessible.

- Build genuine relationships, not transactional ones. The aim is for creators to become long-term advocates of the brand, not one-and-done collaborators.

- Negotiate partnerships that deliver value to us - the goal is to secure as much great content and exposure as possible in exchange for product. We have small budgets, so your skill is in building partnerships where the creator genuinely wants to work with us.

- Manage every relationship from first contact through to content delivered, performance reviewed, and follow-up partnerships agreed.

- Get on video calls or phone calls where it builds the relationship - written outreach alone is not always enough.



3. Strategy and Campaigns

- Plan and run small launches and seasonal campaigns with creators — for example, a Christmas gift-giving push, a Black Friday push, a destination-themed campaign tied to a specific trip.

- Test different outreach angles, message formats, and partnership types. Learn what works and double down.

- Work with the brand owner to identify what content and campaigns we need next — feeding insights back from the creators you speak to.



4. Systems and Tracking

- Keep a clear, organised CRM of every creator contacted, every conversation, where each relationship stands, and what is next.

- Track results: creators contacted, response rate, products shipped, content received, content used, and where possible the traffic and sales each partnership generates.

- Provide daily & weekly summaries of activity and monthly reports on results.



Required Experience

- Hands-on experience with influencer outreach, UGC sourcing, or brand partnerships - ideally for an e-commerce, DTC, or consumer product brand.

- Demonstrable track record. We want to see specific campaigns, response rates, content delivered, and outcomes.

- Excellent written English. Your writing is the job. We will judge you on the actual outreach messages you send.

- Excellent spoken English. You will be on calls with creators and you need to be confident, warm, and articulate.

- Strong judgement about which creators are a genuine fit and which are not. The wrong influencer is worse than no influencer.

- Relationship-building skills. You enjoy talking to people, you find it easy to build rapport, and you follow up consistently.

- Organised and process-driven. Outreach without follow-through is wasted effort.

- Comfortable navigating Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest to find and assess creators.

- Self-direction. We will brief you and trust you to run with it.

- Reliable internet, your own equipment, ability to work 40 hours a week consistently.



Bonus Experience (preferred, not required)

- Existing relationships in the travel creator space.

- Experience running UGC campaigns end-to-end and organising the asset library afterwards.

- Experience with influencer CRM tools (we are open to your recommendations).

- A genuine interest in travel, adventure, or thoughtful gifting.



What We Don't Want

xxx   Templated DMs blasted to hundreds of accounts hoping someone bites

xxx   Focus on follower count over engagement, fit, or audience quality

xxx   Anyone who cannot show real results from past outreach work

xxx   Agencies, outsourced teams, or middlemen

xxx   General virtual assistants without specific outreach experience

xxx    Anyone who treats this as a 6-month gig before moving to the next thing

xxx   Outreach approaches that rely on paying influencers as the main hook - we want relationship-builders, not transaction-managers



What We Offer

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

- Starting salary: USD $1,000 per month, with room to grow to $1,200+ depending on experience, communication skills, and how you present yourself in interviews and calls.

- 13th month bonus.

- Compensation increases over time as you prove the strategy and results.

- Genuine long-term role with significant upside as we scale. 

- Direct collaboration with the founder.

- Clear ownership of the channel. You have autonomy and you are accountable for results.

- Opportunity to shape the role over time - as our influencer and UGC channels mature, you may move into a wider partnerships role.



How To Apply

This is a deliberately detailed application. We do this because we want serious applicants and we want to filter out copy-paste applications at the start. If the steps below feel like too much work, this role is not for you.



Step 1: Send us your application

Subject line: "Outreach Coordinator - [Your Name]"

In the body of the
, please include:

- Brief introduction about yourself.

- Brands you have done outreach work for, with specifics: campaign size, response rates, content delivered, partnerships built, results.

- 2-3 examples of actual outreach messages you have sent that secured a partnership - with the context (which brand, which creator, what the outcome was).

- Your approach to d
 whether a creator is a good fit before reaching out - 3-4 sentences.

- Your view on what is working in influencer outreach in 2026 and what is not.

- A short voice note (1-2 minutes, any phone recording is fine) introducing yourself, telling us why this role interests you, and giving us one example of a partnership you are proud of. This helps us hear your spoken English.

- Tools you currently use for outreach, CRM, and tracking.

Your ideal working hours, and earliest start date.



Step 2: Test task

If selected for the next stage, you will be asked to complete a short test task. This is unpaid and gives us a clear view of how you think, who you would target, and how you would write to them. Details will be sent to shortlisted candidates.



Step 3: Video interview

If selected after the test task, you will be invited to a video interview.



Step 4: Paid trial

Successful candidates start with a three-month paid probation trial the full agreed salary. At the end of this period, both parties d
 whether to continue. If we continue, this is a long-term role.



Why This Role Is Different

This is a genuine opportunity to become the outreach and partnerships lead for a growing brand.

We are not hiring someone to send DMs. We are hiring someone to own a channel, build genuine creator relationships at the heart of how our brand grows, and shape what UGC and influencer marketing look like for us over the next several years.

If that excites you, we want to hear from you.



We respond to qualified applications within 48 hours.

description:
This role supports a growing business through rigorous financial analysis and clear decision support. Proven experience supporting e-commerce or direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

Proven experience building and maintaining complex financial models for business planning and scenario analysis.

Strong background preparing recurring financial reports and conducting variance analysis against budget and forecast.

Experience providing ad hoc financial insights to support management and strategic decisions.

Prior experience operating in a mid- to senior-level analytical role with ownership over financial outputs.

Experience in e-commerce, ideally within the beauty or consumer goods industry, is strongly preferred.

title: PAID ADS SPECIALIST
description:
We are a fast-growing SEO and e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands. We are looking for a Paid Ads Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize high-performing digital advertising campaigns that drive traffic, leads, and revenue growth.



This role is ideal for a performance-driven marketer who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in scaling paid acquisition campaigns across multiple platforms, with strong experience in budget management, audience targeting, keyword research, ad creative testing, A/B testing, and campaign optimization. The role requires continuous monitoring of performance metrics and delivering actionable insights to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency (CPL/ROAS). /Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms and ad compliance



Key Responsibilities:

/Instagram), and LinkedIn, and develop multi-platform paid strategies, including TikTok and other relevant channels.

Develop, test, and optimize ad creatives, copy, and landing page alignment

Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize ROI and reduce acquisition costs

Perform continuous A/B testing on ads, audiences, and campaign structures

Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance metrics (CPC, CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversions)

Identify scaling opportunities and implement data-driven optimization strategies

Collaborate with design and marketing teams to ensure high-performing creatives and messaging.

Leverage hands-on experience with platform algorithms and ad compliance to optimize campaign performance while ensuring strict adherence to advertising policies, platform guidelines, and regulatory standards.



What We’re Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is highly preferred.

 Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, including attribution, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization

Experience using CRM, tracking tools, analytics, and reporting platforms (Google Analytics, Pixel setup, conversion tracking) 

Experience with retargeting, lookalike audiences, and scaling campaigns

Knowledge of creative strategy for paid ads (hooks, angles, ad copy frameworks)

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations 



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) improvement and consistency

Click-Through Rate (CTR) optimization across campaigns

Conversion Rate improvement from paid traffic

Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) efficiency

Campaign scaling performance without loss of ROI

Accuracy and consistency of reporting insights

Nice to Have

Experience with health & wellness or DTC e-commerce brands 

Experience optimizing
 revenue and customer retention funnels 

Familiarity with A/B testing tools and conversion optimization strategies



Schedule 

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required 

Must be fully available for US hours 



What We Offer

Full-time remote role 

Training provided 

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role





How to Apply

Please submit a complete application that includes your resume and a thoughtful, original cover letter.  outreach

title: Senior Revenue Accountant - Global Accounting Operations
description:
Senior Revenue Accountant – Global Accounting Operations

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Compensation: up to 130,000 php



THE COMPANY



DTiQ is a fast-growing global leader in intelligent video-based surveillance and loss prevention solutions, helping businesses improve operations and protect their assets. With over 20 years of experience and more than 45,000 customers worldwide—including well-known brands like Adidas, Burger King, Hard Rock Café, KFC, McDonald’s, US Polo, and Yankee Candle—DTiQ supports over 8 million customer experiences every day.

For more information on DTiQ visit our website (
) or our LinkedIn page (www.
/company/dtiq).



THE ROLE



Application Link: 



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Revenue Accountant to join our growing global finance organization. This role is an exciting opportunity for an accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build deep expertise in revenue accounting, US GAAP compliance, and multinational financial operations within a fast-paced international environment.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical accounting knowledge, hands-on NetSuite experience, and the ability to collaborate across multiple regions and business functions. You will play a critical role in ensuring accurate revenue reporting, maintaining compliance with ASC 606 standards, and supporting global accounting and audit activities across international subsidiaries.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage and support Revenue Recognition processes in compliance with ASC 606, ensuring accurate and timely recognition of revenue across multiple entities and revenue streams.

• Administer and maintain revenue accounting activities using NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), including revenue schedules, contract mapping, and system validations.

• Oversee NetSuite item setup and maintenance, ensuring proper accounting treatment, revenue mapping, and alignment with operational and reporting requirements.

• Prepare, review, and document monthly US GAAP to Local GAAP reconciliations, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and compliance across international reporting requirements.

• Perform detailed Intercompany Reconciliations, including transfer pricing markups, cross-border transactions, and elimination support to ensure accurate global consolidation.

• Support the preparation of annual audit requirements, including schedules, supporting documentation, and auditor inquiries.

• Assist in the drafting and preparation of financial statements and related disclosures.

• Partner with global accounting, FP&A, tax, and operational teams to improve revenue processes and strengthen internal controls.

• Contribute to month-end close activities, process improvements, and accounting automation initiatives.



Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Finance, or related discipline; CPA preferred.

• 5+ years of progressive accounting or revenue accounting experience in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, particularly ASC 606 Revenue Recognition principles.

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite ARM (Advanced Revenue Management) is highly preferred.

• Experience supporting global entities and multi-currency accounting environments.

• Strong understanding of intercompany accounting and consolidation processes.

• Experience supporting annual external audits and financial statement preparation.

• Excellent analytical, reconciliation, and documentation skills with strong attention to detail.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across international teams.



Why This Role?

• Exposure to global accounting operations and international business environments

• Opportunity to work with senior finance leadership

• Career growth in a high-impact accounting role

• Collaborative and supportive global culture

• Competitive compensation and benefits package



If you are a proactive accounting professional looking to expand your international finance experience and make a meaningful impact in a global organization, we’d love to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



Application Link:



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity, but allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day to day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. Your formal contract will come from Ripping and DTiQ will manager your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor — Full-Time
description:
Ji Martial Arts is a premium martial arts performance brand founded by brothers Joshua and Joel Iyalla — elite martial artists with over 35 years of combined experience and a combined social following of 3.5 million. Our founder Joshua Iyalla holds three Guinness World Records, including the world's fastest puncher. UFC fighter Michael "Venom" Page uses and endorses our product.

We are full-time content creators with over 10 years of combined industry experience. We understand content deeply and know exactly what we want. We need an editor who shares that same understanding — someone who can take our vision and execute it with precision, creativity, and genuine craft.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a full-time
 Ads Video Editor to produce high-converting ad creatives for our flagship product — the Ji Full Body Resistance Band — and future products as we scale.

This is a full-time, long-term position. We are not looking for someone fitting us around another job or treating this as a side project. We want someone who is fully in — someone who wakes up thinking about performance, growth, and output. If that is not you, this role is not for you.



WHAT THIS ROLE DEMANDS

This is not a role where you edit one style of ad on repeat. Our creatives span 5 to 10 distinct formats and styles — from cinematic brand storytelling to fast-cut UGC, pattern interrupts, testimonial-style edits, hook-driven direct response, and beyond. You will be expected to move fluidly between them, bringing your own creative instinct to every brief.

We produce 21 video ad creatives per week — 3 per day. That is the standard this role operates at from week one. We understand there is a bedding-in period with our content and style, but the output expectation is there from the start. If that excites you, read on. If it intimidates you, this is not the right fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Monitor our Notion pipeline and begin editing as soon as cards move to Needs Editing — you will be notified via WhatsApp with a voice note or message confirming what needs to be done

- Source clips from our Airtable raw clips library, log everything used, and keep records clean and up to date

- Edit across 5 to 10 distinct ad formats and styles per week, applying your own creative judgement on music, SFX, pacing, and visual effects

- Generate AI voiceovers using ElevenLabs and upload all finished edits to Google Drive following our naming conventions

- Attend a weekly Friday tea
eting and action revision feedback promptly and without hand-holding





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Proven experience editing
 and Instagram ads specifically — a portfolio is required, applications without one will not be reviewed

- Full proficiency in CapCut and the ability to edit across multiple styles and formats — you are not a one-trick pony

- A genuine understanding of consumer psychology and buying behaviour — you know why hooks work, why pacing matters, and - The ability to adapt and learn quickly — we use tools like Airtable and Notion to manage our workflow, both of which are straightforward to pick up. What cannot be taught is creative range, instinct, and versatility — and that is what we are really hiring forwhy the first 2 seconds determine everything

- Full-time availability and complete focus — no other jobs, no split attention, no divided priorities





THE MINDSET WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You are already good. You know it. But you are also hungry to get better. You study ads that perform. You notice what works and why. You bring ideas without being asked. You care about the result — not just the deliverable. You are driven by performance, not just output.

This role includes performance-based bonus potential. When our ads win, you win. We are invested in building a long-term relationship with the right person, and we pay accordingly.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

- You have never edited a paid ad

- You only edit in one style or format

- You have another job and are treating this as secondary

- You are not proficient in CapCut

- You need assets handed to you before you can start

- You need to be told what good pacing looks like

- You cannot commit to full-time hours and full-time focus





GROWTH POTENTIAL:

Ji Martial Arts is scaling fast. As ad volume increases, new products launch, and the brand expands, the right editor will grow with us — in responsibility, in creative ownership, and in earnings. This is a ground-floor opportunity with a brand that has the audience, the product, and the infrastructure to go very large.



TO APPLY

Applications without a portfolio of ad work will not be reviewed.

title: Virtual Receptionist VA (Remote) | Fast Hiring – 24-Hour Review

title: Demand Generation Specialist
description:
The Demand Generation Specialist will be responsible for creating, executing, and optimizing multi-channel marketing campaigns that generate high-quality, sales-ready leads (MQLs) and accelerate pipeline growth. This role requires a strong blend of analytical skill, creative campaign execution, and technical marketing expertise within a complex B2G/B2I sales environment. The ideal candidate has 3+ years of hands-on experience in an agency environment, primarily managing the technical execution of demand generation campaigns in a B2B environment, with a demonstrable track record of improving MQL velocity and quality. This is a Full-Time Remote based role.



Responsibilities & Duties

Campaign Deployment: They are responsible for the hands-on building and launching of all lead generation campaigns.

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): They own the testing and optimization of all conversion points—landing pages, forms, and calls-to-action (CTAs). By improving conversion rates by even a few percentage points, they can instantly boost lead volume without increasing ad spend, directly accelerating lead generation efficiency.

Budget Efficiency: They manage the day-to-day bidding and targeting in advertising platforms, ensuring the budget is spent on high-performing segments and channels, which lowers the Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and makes growth more sustainable.

MarTech Management: They manage the technical connections between advertising platforms such as LinkedIn, Google and our source of truth (HubSpot). This ensures reliable data flow, preventing "leaks" in the funnel where valuable leads might be lost.

Lead Nurturing Mechanics: They build, test, and segment the automated
 nurture tracks, ensuring MQLs who aren't yet sales-ready remain engaged with relevant, value-driven content until they show enough intent for a sales handoff.

Lead Follow up: Proactively follow up with new prospects after a webinar and after new prospects have connected with the S2C team at an event.

Reporting: Ensure accurate reporting of new leads and conversations generated.

Audience Segmentation: They execute precise audience targeting based on defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs)(e.g., industry, revenue, size, specific titles, existing technology).

Other duties as assigned.



What Success Looks Like

Pipeline generation meets/exceeds goals, becomes more consistent, measurable, and repeatable

The expectation will be to generate 50 net new leads per week, or 200 net news leads per month (you d
 on channel mix)

Marketing and Sales operate with clearer handoffs and strong alignment

HubSpot reporting becomes more trusted and actionable

Messaging and campaigns become sharper, more strategic, and more effective

Leadership gains better visibility into what marketing is contributing and where to invest next

title: Build a HIPAA-compliant, multi-specialty SMS + LLM patient engagement platform for a healthcare billing company
description:
Type: Fixed-price · Timeline: 9 weeks · Engagement: Greenfield build with a written specification



What we’re building

We are a multi-specialty medical billing service serving four specialties: behavioral health (therapy, psychiatry), dental, physical therapy, and chiropractic. We’re building an SMS-first AI patient engagement platform that runs on top of the billing service we already provide to our clients. Patients text the practice number; an LLM with tool access handles scheduling, reschedules, reminders, new-patient intake, dental recall, treatment-plan adherence, FAQ, and missed-appointment recovery. Humans handle anything the LLM shouldn’t — clinical risk, escalations, complex billing questions. The system is multi-tenant, specialty-aware (practice config sets specialty at onboarding and the system uses specialty-specific reminder cadence, intake fields, FAQ defaults, prompt templates, and escalation triggers from there), HIPAA-compliant, and deployed once to be resold to every practice we bill for.



This is not a research project. There’s a written specification with feature-level acceptance criteria, a pinned stack, milestone breakdowns, and commercial terms. You’ll get it after a short screening exchange. Read it before you bid.



What you’ll deliver

A production-ready backend, admin UI, and infrastructure-as-code, ready for two paying-patient pilot practices at the end of week 9 — ideally across two different specialties to validate the specialty-config layer. Specifically:



Node.js 20 + TypeScript + Fastify API and worker on AWS ECS Fargate

PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, Prisma ORM, pg-boss queue

Claude Haiku 4.5 via AWS Bedrock with tool-calling

Twilio Programmable Messaging with 10DLC A2P registration

Google Calendar, Microsoft Graph, and ICS read-only calendar drivers

Next.js + shadcn/ui admin console for our internal operators

Terraform for the full AWS footprint

Operational runbooks, restore drill, and live handoff to our team

What’s out of scope

Listed here so no one wastes time bidding work we will reject:



Voice / IVR (SMS-only for v1)

Clinical AI of any kind (triage, assessment, symptom checking)

Insurance verification, VOB, eligibility checks, or member-ID collection — our billing team owns this separately

Insurance card OCR / MMS handling

EHR write-back (calendar integration only)

Mobile apps, patient web portal, payment processing

Multi-language (English only for v1)

External penetration test (we’ll commission this separately, post-handoff)

What you need to know about compliance

HIPAA is non-negotiable across all four specialties. BAAs required from you and every sub-processor. No PHI in logs. AWS Bedrock is the only LLM provider allowed (BAA-covered). TCPA: 10DLC registration, opt-in capture, STOP/HELP handling, quiet hours. Crisis-language routing is enabled only for behavioral-health-specialty practices; dental, PT, and chiropractic practices use the same escalation tool with specialty-appropriate copy. If you’ve never shipped a HIPAA-regulated production system, this isn’t your project.



Working agreement

Minimum 3 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time, Monday–Friday

Daily async standup in Slack (one paragraph: yesterday, today, blockers)

Weekly 30-minute sync call

Code, PRs, commits, and documentation in English

Fixed-price, milestone-based payment (net 15 after acceptance)

How we’ll pick

Bids are scored on five criteria:



Relevant HIPAA / multi-specialty healthcare experience — 30%

Technical fit with the pinned stack — 20%

Quality of the bid response — 20%

Price (value, not lowest) — 20%

Communication quality — 10%

We’ll shortlist 2–3 bids for a short paid spike (a few hours of work, scope and rate agreed in writing) to validate hands-on aptitude before awarding the full engagement.



Required to apply — bids missing any of these will not be evaluated

Two references for HIPAA or healthcare engagements completed in the last 24 months. Name,
, one sentence on your scope.

One link to a GitHub or sample repository you wrote or led — Node/TypeScript preferred, IaC visible if possible.

One paragraph (?200 words) on the prior project most relevant to this build: what you owned, what was hard.

A redacted team org chart (lead, backend, frontend, infra). Solo bids OK if you explain how you’ll cover illness, vacation, and oncall.

A fixed-price bid broken down by milestone (six milestones, M0–M5).

Your timeline per milestone. Concur or disagree with the 9-week total.

What you’d remove from scope to finish in 6 weeks. What you’d add with 2 more.

Next step

Reply with the items above. We’ll send the full spec to bidders that pass the first read. Questions before submitting: ask in your application — 48-hour turnaround.

This is not a traditional role. We are not looking for a VA or a marketer or an analyst. We are looking for an AI Generalist -- someone who sees a problem and immediately asks: how do I use AI to solve this better, faster, and at a higher standard than a human team could alone.

 

If you think AI is a tool you use occasionally, this role is not for you. If AI is how you think -- read on.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

+ Translating business problems into AI prompts, workflows and solutions -- without waiting to be told how.

QUALITIES WE VALUE:

REQUIREMENTS:

s.

- Optimizing outbound messaging

- Driving measurable performance improvements

- Process & Script Adherence: Ensure BDRs consistently follow defined outreach processes, scripts, and campaign guidelines. - - - Monitor activity, identify gaps, and enforce quality standards across all touchpoints.

- BDR Performance Management: Track and evaluate BDR performance against key metrics (e.g., call quality, conversion rates, meetings booked). 

- Conduct regular performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and implement coaching plans to improve individual and team results.

- Performance Reviews: Present results to clients, explain insights, and recommend campaign adjustments.

- Feedback Loop: Translate performance data and field insights into updated messaging, ICP targeting, or scripts.

- Client Success: Act as the main point of contact for multiple clients. Run onboarding calls, planning sessions, and ongoing check-ins.

- Campaign Strategy: Define Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP), messaging frameworks, and outreach playbooks.

- Scripting Ownership: Write and refine cold calling scripts and cold

- List Coordination: Work with the List Building Team to deliver accurate, targeted contact lists that align with each client’s ICP.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with Operations to deploy new workflows, processes, and tools across the agency.



What We’re Looking For

- Hands-on B2B cold calling experience (minimum 1–2 years). You’ve done the job and know what works on the phones.

- 2+ years experience training, coaching, and improving BDR/SDR performance (call reviews, feedback, ongoing development).

- 2+ years in Account Management, Business Development, Client Success, or Campaign Management (ideally in B2B services, lead generation, or sales outsourcing).

- Strong copywriting/scripting skills, able to write persuasive cold call scripts and outbound
 templates.

- Solid understanding of outbound prospecting (cold calling, cold
, ICP design).

- Strong communication and relationship management skills (English, written + spoken).

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts at once without dropping details.

- Experience working with remote teams and tools like HubSpot, Slack, Coda, Calendly, and dialers (Nooks, Aircall, etc.).

- Comfortable and proficient at working with AI tools.



What We Offer

- USD 1,500 base pay + commission based on BDR Team performance

- Remote-first team across multiple countries.

- The chance to own both client relationships and outbound campaign design.

- Career growth opportunities as we scale our Account Management team.

title: VSL Cutter
description:
Video Editor Needed – VSL Specialist in the Health Niche (Long-Term Position)



We are a fast-growing direct response brand in the health niche, currently spending over $10,000/month on ads – and scaling rapidly.



We're looking for a skilled Video Sales Letter (VSL) editor to join our team on a long-term basis.



What you'll do:



You'll receive fully written VSL scripts and turn them into high-converting video sales letters in the health space. These are typically 3–5 minutes long, sometimes longer. Your job is to cut and edit the VSL, **find and source fitting clips, stock footage, and b-roll that match the script and the health niche, and produce a polished final video – with the right pacing, energy, and structure that makes VSLs convert.



What we're looking for:



- Proven experience editing and cutting VSLs specifically (not just general video editing)

- Experience or strong interest in the health/wellness niche

- Ability to independently search for and select fitting video clips, stock footage, and visual elements that support the script's message

- You understand direct response pacing, pattern interrupts, visual hooks, and how to keep viewers engaged

- Comfortable working with screen recordings, kinetic text, and b-roll

- Ability to deliver polished 3–5 minute+ VSLs on a consistent basis

- Reliable, communicative, and able to meet deadlines



Please include in your application:



- 2–3 examples of VSLs you have edited (links or files) – health niche preferred

- A brief note on your editing process and how you source clips/footage

- Your availability and preferred working hours



What we offer:



We pay per video, starting at a fair rate for 3–5 minute VSLs. As we see consistent quality and results, we increase pay accordingly. We value loyalty and want someone who grows with us – not a one-off freelancer.



If you have real VSL experience and want to be part of a health brand that's scaling fast, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Housing Specialist
description:
JOHNSON HOMES

Housing Specialist



Position Type: Administrative / Business Development



Department: Housing Development & Partner Relations



Reports To: Director of Placement (or VP of Operations)



Company: Johnson Homes

Tagline: “Your Home is Where Our Heart Is”



Position Summary

The Housing Specialist is an administrative and relationship-focused role responsible for developing, securing, onboarding, and maintaining housing opportunities for Johnson Homes placements. This position primarily works with housing partners, care homes, group homes, assisted living providers, landlords, and individuals interested in operating or purchasing an existing care home business.



Unlike Placement Coordinators who focus on clients, the Housing Specialist focuses on building and maintaining the housing inventory pipeline that supports Johnson Homes placements.



This role is heavily administrative and partnership-driven and requires strong communication, organization, follow-up, and social media engagement skills. Role requires building and maintaining a shareable database of all housing partners.



Primary Purpose of the Role

To ensure Johnson Homes consistently has quality housing options available by:



-Recruiting and onboarding housing partners

-Maintaining partner relationships

-Managing partner agreements and contracts

-Posting and responding to housing opportunities

-Supporting individuals interested in opening, operating, or purchasing care homes

-Building a reliable housing inventory for elderly, disabled, and behavioral health placements



Core Responsibilities

1. Housing Partner Development

Recruit new care homes, group homes, assisted living providers, sponsorship homes, and supportive housing providers into the Johnson Homes network.

Build relationships with:

Care home owners

Adult foster care providers

Residential operators

Landlords willing to partner with Johnson Homes

Individuals interested in operating care homes

Identify new housing opportunities through:

Social media

 groups

Community partnerships

Networking

Online marketplaces

Referrals



2. Partner Agreements & Contract Management

Manage administrative documentation related to housing partners, including:

Preferred Provider Partner Agreements

Housing Partner Contracts

Referral Agreements

Care Home Participation Agreements

Provider onboarding paperwork

Orientation documents

Compliance checklists

Licensing verification documents

Responsible for:

Sending agreements

Tracking signatures

Following up on incomplete documents

Maintaining organized partner records

Ensuring onboarding packets are completed



3. Provider Onboarding & Orientation

Coordinate onboarding for new housing providers by:

Conducting Johnson Homes orientation

Explaining expectations and standards

Reviewing referral processes

Explaining Johnson Homes policies

Teaching response timelines

Reviewing placement procedures

Verifying required documentation

Topics may include:

Housing expectations

Communication standards

Resident support expectations

Required updates

Billing/payment expectations

Working with Johnson Homes care partners



4. Housing Lead Generation

Generate housing opportunities through proactive outreach.

Lead sources include:

 Marketplace

 care home groups

Social media advertisements

Craigslist

Caregiver communities

Existing care home operators

Assisted living and group home owners

Networking events

Word of mouth

Responsibilities:

Post opportunities consistently

Respond to inbound leads

Screen potential housing partners

Schedule follow-up calls

Maintain lead tracking system



5. Existing Care Home Contract Opportunities

Manage inquiries related to individuals interested in:

Running an existing care home

Purchasing an existing care home contract

Partnering with Johnson Homes to operate a home

Becoming a sponsored housing provider

Responsibilities include:

Posting opportunities online

Responding to inquiries

Conducting initial screening calls

Explaining Johnson Homes partnership opportunities

Coordinating next steps with leadership



6. Housing Inventory Management

Maintain a current housing database that includes:

Open beds

Housing type

Level of care

Accepted funding sources

Medicaid status

Private pay availability

Geographic service areas

Special populations served

Ensure housing availability is updated regularly.



Daily Responsibilities

Respond to housing inquiries

Post social media housing opportunities

Follow up with partner leads

Send onboarding packets

Review contracts

Conduct orientation calls

Track provider status

Maintain housing inventory

Coordinate with Placement Coordinators regarding placement availability

Required Skills

Strong administrative skills

Excellent communication

Organization and documentation management

Social media marketing experience

Ability to build relationships

Follow-up and lead management

Professional phone etiquette

CRM/database tracking experience preferred



Ideal Candidate

The ideal Housing Specialist is:

? Relationship-driven

? Organized and detail-oriented

? Strong at follow-up

? Comfortable communicating with providers

? Skilled at social media engagement

? Passionate about helping elderly and disabled individuals find stable housing



Key Performance Metrics (KPIs)

Housing Specialist success may be measured by:

Number of new housing partners added monthly

Number of onboarding packets completed

Contracts executed

Open beds secured

Response time to leads

Social media lead generation

Housing inventory growth

Number of active provider relationships

Placement success through secured housing



Example Monthly Goals

15–20 new housing partner conversations

10–15 completed onboarding packets

5–10 new active housing providers

10+ social media housing posts weekly

95% follow-up response rate



Internal Role Distinction

Housing Specialist = Housing/Partner Side

Focuses on finding and managing housing resources

Placement Coordinator = Client Side

Focuses on finding placements for clients

The two roles work together closely to maximize placement success.

Job Summary

We are an established music school in New York City, seeking a highly organized and enthusiastic Interview Appointment Booker to support the admissions process at our music school. Coordinate and book interview appointments for prospective students with admissions staff or faculty, based on availability and program requirements.

Strong organizational and time-management abilities



Excellent verbal and written communication skills



Friendly and professional customer service approach, with an enthusiastic and engaging phone manner

Understanding of music school environments or educational settings



Spanish language skills are a plus



Experience with organic lead generation (e.g., through social media engagement, community outreach, or word-of-mouth referrals) is a strong advantage



Compensation

This is a part-time position with a performance-based compensation structure:

Total commission earnings based on successful bookings and/or enrollments

title: Founding Online ESL Teacher for Young Learners Ages 6–7
description:
We are building a quality-first online English foundation program for young Chinese learners aged 6–7 who are complete beginners or near-beginners in English.



This is not a random teacher-booking platform, and not a typical ESL class.



We are looking for a very small number of truly suitable founding teachers who can help us build the first classroom standard.



Class model:

- Online small-group teaching

- 1 teacher + 4 children

- Fixed teacher

- Fixed students

- Fixed time slot

- Around 25 minutes per class

- Main teaching hours: 4:30 PM – 9:00 PM Philippine time

- One full learning cycle: around 48 weeks



Who we are looking for:



You may be:

- an ESL teacher with young learner experience

- a kindergarten or preschool teacher

- an early childhood education teacher

- a preschool / kindergarten English teacher

- a bilingual or international school young learner teacher



We care less about your title and more about whether you are truly suitable for teaching 6–7-year-old complete beginners in an online 1v4 small-group class.



Required qualities:



We are looking for someone who:

- has experience teaching children aged 5–8 or early primary learners

- genuinely enjoys teaching young children

- understands young learners’ emotions, attention span, and classroom behavior

- can gently but effectively manage shy, silent, distracted, overexcited, or restless children

- can use TPR, gestures, pictures, repetition, routines, and scaffolding to help children understand and participate

- has strong on-camera presence and a warm, child-friendly personality

- has clear, natural, and stable English pronunciation

- is willing to follow lesson SOPs, receive training, and join post-class reviews

- has long-term cooperation potential



Bonus points:

- online young learner teaching experience

- 1v4 or small-group teaching experience

- experience with ClassIn or similar online teaching platforms

- Cambridge Power Up / YLE / Cambridge curriculum experience

- kindergarten / preschool / early childhood education background

- real young learner teaching video samples



Cooperation:



The early stage may start with part-time / trial cooperation.



If both sides are a strong fit, we hope this can grow into stable long-term monthly cooperation.



Because the learning cycle is around 48 weeks, we strongly prefer teachers who are willing to stay with the children for at least one full learning cycle.



For a highly suitable founding teacher, we are willing to offer:

- PHP 40,000–50,000 per month, depending on workload, responsibilities, availability, and fit

- stable long-term cooperation opportunity

- lesson SOP and training support

- opportunity to grow with the founding team

- possible future path toward Lead Teacher / Teacher Trainer / Teaching Quality Support



Application materials:



Please prepare:



1. CV / resume



2. A 3–5 minute self-introduction video — required



In your self-introduction video, please include:

- your name and teaching background

- your experience with young learners, especially ages 5–8

- your online teaching experience, if any

- why you think you may be suitable for 6–7-year-old beginner learners

- one example of how you handled a young child who was silent, distracted, emotional, overexcited, or unwilling to participate



Applications without a self-introduction video will not be prioritized.



3. Previous teaching video — strongly preferred



This is especially helpful if:

- the students are aged 5–8

- it is an online class

- it is a group class

- it shows your real teaching style, energy, voice, TPR, and classroom interaction



4. Available teaching hours



Please clearly state your availability, especially between 4:30 PM and 9:00 PM Philippine time.



5. Equipment and teaching environment



Please briefly share your:

- device

- headset / microphone

- camera

- internet connection

- teaching space



Selection process:

1. Application screening

2. Self-introduction video review

3. Video interview

4. Short paid teaching audition

5. Part-time / trial cooperation

6. Long-term cooperation if both sides are a strong fit



Important note:



We are not mass hiring.



We are not looking for the most teachers.



We are looking for the right teachers.



Generic applications will not be prioritized. Please read the role carefully and apply only if you truly enjoy teaching young children and believe you may be suitable for beginner learners in an online small-group class.



To show that you have read this post carefully, please start your application message with: “Benova Young Learner”.



If you have patience, classroom energy, clear English, strong young learner teaching ability, and are interested in helping build a quality-first young learner English program from the early stage, we would love to hear from you.

title: Content Manager
description:
CONTENT MANAGER

Remote · Part-Time to Full-Time · Long-Term

Tony Richards · Renaissance Properties LLC · Montgomery, Alabama USA



WHO YOU'D BE WORKING FOR

My name is Tony Richards. I'm a real estate investor and entrepreneur based in Montgomery, Alabama. I've been building for 20+ years — 300+ rental doors, 60+ Airbnb units, and 8 active companies including a property management operation, auto dealerships, a roll-off dumpster company, and a wholesale distribution warehouse.



I also have a growing personal brand with 18,000+
 followers and tens of thousands of views on content I create around real estate, wealth building, and faith-driven entrepreneurship. People follow me because I show them the real operation — not theory, not fluff.



I'm building out a content engine — social media, a paid subscription, digital courses, and a high-ticket mentorship program. I need a right-hand person to run the content side so I can stay focused on operating my companies.



THE ROLE

This is not a social media poster job. This is a Content Manager role — the person who takes everything I'm already doing and turns it into organized, scheduled, on-brand content across all platforms and revenue streams.

Your core job:

• Watch raw video footage I send you and d
 how to use it — what becomes a free Reel, what becomes subscription content, what becomes course material

• Write captions, scripts, and overlay text in my exact voice and brand tone

• Brief my video editor (Frans) on exactly how to cut each piece

• Manage the monthly content calendar — what posts on what day, on what platform

• Upload exclusive content to my
 Subscription page on schedule

• Monitor comments and DMs, flag anything that needs my personal response

• Keep everything organized so nothing falls through the cracks



WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK LOOKS LIKE

• Monday: Review raw footage from the weekend, plan the week's content

• Tuesday–Thursday: Write captions, brief Frans, schedule posts via Meta Business Suite

• Friday: Upload that week's exclusive subscriber video, prep next week's calendar

• Ongoing: Monitor comments, track engagement, flag high-performing content for repurposing

Estimated hours: 20–30 per week to start, growing to full-time as the operation scales.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This role is for someone who is organized, proactive, and takes ownership. If you need constant direction, this is not the right fit.

You must have:

• Proven experience managing social media content for a personal brand, entrepreneur, or business

• Strong English writing skills — you will be writing in someone else's voice daily

• Experience with Meta Business Suite or similar scheduling tools

• Understanding of short-form video content (Reels, TikTok-style content)

• Ability to identify what makes content perform — hooks, captions, timing

• Highly organized — you will manage a content calendar across multiple platforms

• Self-starter who communicates proactively and hits deadlines without being chased

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

• Experience with Canva or basic graphic tools

• Background in real estate, investing, or financial content

• Experience managing a paid subscription community (Patreon,
 Subscriptions, etc.)



WHAT YOU WON'T BE DOING

You will not be filming content — I handle that.

You will not be editing video — Frans handles that.

You will not be doing property management or anything related to my real estate companies.

You will not be expected to work US business hours — results matter, not when you're at your desk.



COMPENSATION

Starting: $500–$800 USD/month (part-time) · $900–$1,400 USD/month (full-time) · Based on experience and output quality



This is a long-term role with real growth potential. As my brand and revenue scales, your compensation scales with it. I'm not looking for someone to fill a seat — I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with an operation that is already moving.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, your application must include ALL of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



• Your resume or work history

• 2–3 examples of social media content you have managed or written (links or screenshots)

• A short paragraph — in your own words — explaining why you are the right person for this role

• Answer this question: You receive a 4-minute raw video of a real estate investor walking through a house flip in progress, talking about what's been spent so far. What would you do with it? Be specific.

That last question is the most important part of your application. It tells me immediately whether you understand this role.



TONY RICHARDS · RENAISSANCE PROPERTIES LLC

Montgomery, Alabama USA

It is essential that the applicant demonstrates compassion and empathy toward patients, ensuring they feel supported, informed, and at ease throughout their care journey, while also maintaining strong professionalism in communication with partnered offices to support effective collaboration and continuity of care. This position also requires strong organizational skills, reliability, and the ability to manage a high-volume workflow with accuracy and attention to detail.

- Request, track, and follow up on medical records and consents.

- Maintain accurate notes, patient charts, and Google Calendar updates.

- Ensure schedules and documentation are correct and up to date at all times.



4. Team Collaboration & Coverage

- Provide coverage for other Patient Coordinators when needed.

- Share updates and pending tasks with the team during shift changes.

- Work collaboratively in a high-volume environment, covering 20+ offices weekly with multiple patients per schedule.



Candidate Requirements (Required)

- Previous experience in dental or healthcare administration is preferred.

- Excellent communication (English) and interpersonal abilities.

- Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

- Proven ability to multitask effectively and thrive in a fast-paced setting.

- A firm commitment to delivering outstanding patient care.



Technical/Work Environment Requirements (Required)

- Must have access to two computer screens.

- Must have a backup internet connection in case of power outages.



Key Traits

- Professional, empathetic, and patient-focused.

- Highly organized with sharp attention to detail.

- Adaptable and able to thrive under pressure.

- Reliable, proactive, and accountable in a remote work environment.

- Strong communicator and collaborative team player.



Work Schedule:

Eight (8) hours between 5:30AM-6:00PM PST (Monday-Friday)



If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of patients and are committed to excellence, we encourage you to apply for the Patient Care Coordinator position at Elite Sedation. Join us in our mission to set the gold standard for anesthesia services through quality patient care.
